facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - permit and isolation certificate records incomplete for HO-9401

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on HO-9401 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on HO-9401 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. HO-9401 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 June 2026 a planned assurance activity of HO-9401 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
